interpretation.conclusion: The allocation mechanism showed no advantage in this frozen development epoch. Wrong quantitative forecasts and unsuccessful revisions occurred with successful provider delivery. This does not isolate the model weights from reasoning-disabled configuration, and is not a fresh held-out generalization claim.
interpretation.proposedCorrection: Before replacing the model or adding cognitive layers, compare supported reasoning-enabled inference without the rejected reasoning_budget field against the simpler current integration on fresh tasks and report realized compute. Preserve prediction custody and use externally checked quantitative derivations rather than confidence voting.
interpretation.historicalComparison: The older direct-emission epoch was provider-confounded. Completing this epoch does not establish a causal cognitive improvement over it.

conflicts: A more elaborate allocation policy spent more reported tokens and achieved fewer accepted outcomes; it remains experimental rather than replacing the simpler integration.
